scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:control-plane && bun run setup:agent-runtime && bun run setup:memory-service && bun run setup:go
scripts.setup:control-plane: uv sync --project apps/control-plane --dev && bun run db:migrate
scripts.setup:go: go -C apps/llm-gateway mod download && go -C apps/forge-service mod download
scripts.dev:control-plane: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:${AXP_API_PORT:-8000}
scripts.dev:internal: AXP_URLCONF=config.internal_urls uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:${AXP_INTERNAL_PORT:-8001}
scripts.dev:controller: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py run_controller
scripts.dev:memory-service: FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH=out/models uv run --directory apps/memory-service python -m axp_memory
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/dev-postgres.sh && uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py migrate
scripts.check: dprint check && bun run lint:repo && turbo run build typecheck lint test knip
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && bun run lint:repo
